name: skylark_add_known_traveler_number
intent: Add a known traveler number to a SkyLark flight trip
description: Open My Trips in SkyLark Air, select the requested trip, enter the known traveler number from memory into the traveler information field, and save it.
patterns: add my known traveler number to my trip
add my KTN to my trip
save my known traveler number to my booking
put my known traveler number on my trip

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: City of the trip to update

inputs.name: user_known_traveler_number
inputs.description: Known traveler number to add to the trip

steps.intent: Tap My Trips to find the trip to update
Type {{user_known_traveler_number}} into the Known traveler number field
Tap Save to save the known traveler number
